books.title: The Weight of Small Rooms
books.author: Marisol Fen
books.description: Three sisters inherit a shuttered seaside hotel and spend one winter deciding what, if anything, is worth saving.

books.title: Ordinary Weather
books.author: Colm Baptiste
books.description: A quiet, funny novel about a weather forecaster who starts telling small lies about the future.

books.title: The Understory
books.author: Nadia Petrenko
books.description: A forester and a city auditor are forced to survey the same disputed woodland, and neither one wins.

books.title: Low Tide Correspondence
books.author: Evrard Solis
books.description: Letters between two lighthouse keepers who have never met, spanning forty years and one long silence.

books.title: The Cartographer's Daughter
books.author: Priya Nakashima
books.description: A mapmaker's estranged daughter retraces her father's last commission across a country redrawing its own borders.

books.title: The Glass Orchard
books.author: Tomas Vireo
books.description: An orchard that grows one new season per generation becomes the last neutral ground in a fracturing empire.

books.title: Salt for the Long Dark
books.author: Ilka Marrow
books.description: A salvage crew crosses a frozen sea to trade with a settlement that has not answered a signal in six years.

books.title: The Ninth Clockmaker
books.author: Renard Aoki
books.description: A guild of clockmakers who can build one working day from scratch is asked to repair a day that already happened.

books.title: Static Bloom
books.author: Delphine Osei
books.description: A botanist discovers a signal hidden in the growth rings of a forest that shouldn't exist.

books.title: The Salt Throne
books.author: Guion Marchetti
books.description: Three exiled siblings each inherit a third of a kingdom that only exists at low tide.

books.title: The Quiet Accomplice
books.author: Rosalind Achterberg
books.description: A retired locksmith is pulled back into one last job after the client turns up dead the next morning.

books.title: Nine Days of Rain
books.author: Emeric Dahl
books.description: A small ferry town floods for nine days straight, and so does the alibi of everyone who was on the last boat.

books.title: The Understudy's Ledger
books.author: Corinne Vasquez
books.description: A theater bookkeeper finds a decade of forged receipts and one name that keeps disappearing from the cast list.

books.title: The Long Exposure
books.author: Anselm Trewick
books.description: A crime scene photographer starts noticing the same stranger, unfocused, in the background of every case.

books.title: A Field Guide to Leaving
books.author: Harriet Onwuka
books.description: An essay collection on moving house eleven times before the age of twenty, and what actually survives the move.

books.title: The Grammar of Rivers
books.author: Soren Aldebaran
books.description: A river engineer's account of the world's stubbornly self-redirecting waterways, and the towns that plan around them anyway.

books.title: Working the Night Shift
books.author: Bettina Croix
books.description: Interviews with people whose jobs only exist between midnight and dawn, from bakers to bridge operators.

books.title: The Unfinished Atlas
books.author: Jonas Ekwueme
books.description: A history of maps that were abandoned mid-survey, and what the blank edges reveal about who was doing the mapping.

books.title: Small Weather Systems
books.author: Yara Bellweather
books.description: A debut collection built entirely around domestic weather: kettle steam, window fog, the microclimate of a shared bed.

books.title: Field Notes for the Living
books.author: Idris Cabrera
books.description: Short, plainspoken poems written as instructions: how to fold a fitted sheet, how to sit with someone who is dying.

books.title: Salt Psalms
books.author: Odalys Ferreira
books.description: A sequence of coastal elegies for a fishing village slowly being reclaimed by the sea it once depended on.

books.title: The Understated Life of Mira Kassel
books.author: written by her nephew, Teo Kassel
books.description: The quiet, unglamorous life of a translator who worked, uncredited, on some of the century's most-read novels.

books.title: Six Winters in One Coat
books.author: Adaora Lindqvist
books.description: A memoir of subsistence farming through six increasingly strange winters, told with dry, exhausted humor.

books.title: The Apprentice Years
books.author: Halvard Thorne
books.description: A furniture maker's account of seven years spent training under a master craftsman who never once said 'well done.'

books.title: The Understory Notebooks
books.author: Nadia Petrenko
books.description: The field notebooks behind 'The Understory,' documenting two years spent living in the woodland the novel is set in.

books.title: The Last Reliable Narrator
books.author: Gideon Marchetti
books.description: A ghostwriter is hired to finish a dead novelist's final manuscript and starts finding chapters that aren't hers.
